_comment: NAMES ONLY search index for Tribal land areas (U3b, D-STD-012; safe matcher and provenance gate per D-0.7.0-026). No polygons, and no coordinates outside headquarters: a search selection queries the live AIAN-LAR service for the extent at selection time. provenance safe-match: displayName is the formal Federal Register Tribe name, matched under the safety rules in scripts/build-tribal-roster.mjs. provenance lar-label: displayName is the BIA land-area label verbatim (no Tribe mapping is guessed). censusAreas: Census AIANNH federal areas (names only; a search selection queries the live Census service): every OTSA, TDSA and ANVSA, plus reservation and trust land areas only for Tribes AIAN-LAR does not locate, so a Nation can appear both as a LAR land area and as a Census statistical area. provenance census-label keeps the Census name verbatim. A statistical area the label map names with one Nation carries that Nation, and a Nation the label map names that has no other row has one row per area that names it, so an area several Nations share has several rows. labelAreas: Census AIANNH code to the Federal Register names the Tribal Lands layer labels that area with (every federal row the Census matcher resolves, reservations included, plus the rows confirmed against the US EPA Tribal Areas tables, which publish the Census area id beside the Tribe, and the areas tribal-label-names.json areaNames labels as one band, place or community of its Nation; "(previously listed as ...)" dropped). A censusAreas row with stateArea true is a state-recognized Census area pinned to a Nation no other row finds (never in labelAreas). headquarters: for each other Nation neither boundary source draws, its headquarters town (Census place code, town, State, source page) and the place's Census internal point [lon, lat]: a town point, never an area. Regenerate with `npm run build:tribal-roster`.

meta.matcher: LAR areas, safe-match v2 (D-0.7.0-026): unique whole-phrase containment, state-constrained, distinctive-token guard; plus the maintainer-curated known-ambiguous gate (D-0.7.0-026a); then rule 10: a remaining BIA label takes the Nations of its one same-name Census reservation
meta.censusMatcher: Census areas (rule 7): maintainer-curated known-ambiguous gate (D-0.7.0-026a) first; then unique whole-phrase containment of BASENAME outside the roster name parentheses, or equality with a parenthetical, distinctive-token guard; several candidates resolve only when exactly one carries BASENAME as its parenthetical; no state constraint
meta.censusSource: US Census Bureau TIGERweb AIANNH layer 47 (names only)
meta.headquartersSource: US Census Bureau TIGERweb Places, incorporated and census designated places (internal point)
